LanguageData.VREW_Mutation_Randomizer.description: Once a pawn receives this gene, it will transform itself into 1-3 random mutations.
LanguageData.VREW_Mutation_Randomizer.label: randomizer
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionAccuracy.description: Carriers of this gene achieve improved steadiness and precision in polluted environments. As pollution levels rise, their aiming capabilities are enhanced, allowing them to target and strike with remarkable accuracy.
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionAccuracy.label: pollution accuracy
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionCognition.description: Carriers of this gene exhibit enhanced focus and learning abilities in polluted environments. As pollution levels rise, their capacity to acquire new skills and retain knowledge expands.
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionCognition.label: pollution cognition
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionFertility.description: Carriers of this gene have a boost to fertility in polluted environments, allowing for increased offspring production and faster lineage expansion in hazardous conditions.
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionFertility.label: pollution fertility
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionHappiness.description: Carriers of this gene enjoy heightened levels of happiness in polluted environments, experiencing increased joy and contentment as pollution levels rise, making them thrive in otherwise gloomy conditions.
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionHappiness.label: pollution happiness
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionNumbness.description: Carriers of this gene experience reduced pain sensations in polluted environments as pollution levels increase.
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionNumbness.label: pollution numbness
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionProductivity.description: Carriers of this gene find their work speed significantly improved in polluted environments, allowing them to complete tasks more efficiently and swiftly as pollution levels increase.
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionProductivity.label: pollution productivity
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionPsySensitivity.description: Carriers of this gene experience amplified psychic sensitivity in polluted environments, leading to stronger intuition and telepathic skills as pollution levels increase.
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionPsySensitivity.label: pollution psy-sensitivity
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionRage.description: Carriers of this gene experience amplified close-quarters damage output in polluted environments. As pollution levels escalate, their ferocity and strength intensify, allowing them to inflict greater harm on their adversaries.
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionRage.label: pollution rage
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionRegeneration.description: Carriers of this gene benefit from accelerated natural healing in polluted environments. As pollution levels increase, their regenerative abilities are boosted, enabling them to recover from injuries and restore their vitality more rapidly.
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionRegeneration.label: pollution regeneration
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionRush.description: Carriers of this gene get a chemical rush from being exposed to pollution. This makes them move faster and helps them think clearer. A similar gene is found in combat-engineered mega-insects.
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionRush.label: pollution stimulus
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionSustenance.description: Carriers of this gene possess the remarkable ability to derive nutrition from pollution. In polluted environments, they can absorb vital nutrients from the air, slowing down their hunger rate.
LanguageData.VREW_PollutionSustenance.label: pollution sustenance
LanguageData.VRE_Instability_Extreme.description: Carriers of this gene need very little metabolic energy to stay alive, at the cost of extremely-reduced stability in their cell-replication machinery.
LanguageData.VRE_Instability_Extreme.label: extreme cell instability
LanguageData.VRE_Instability_Nominal.description: Carriers of this gene need slightly less metabolic energy to stay alive, at the cost of reduced stability in their cell-replication machinery.
LanguageData.VRE_Instability_Nominal.label: nominal cell instability
LanguageData.VRE_Instability_Progressive.description: Carriers of this gene have their genetic code becoming progressively more unstable with every new generation.
LanguageData.VRE_Instability_Progressive.label: progressive cell instability
LanguageData.VRE_ToxAbsorption.description: Carriers of this gene have the extraordinary ability to directly absorb toxic gases through their skin. This gene does not have any effect in itself, but it does increase the speed at which pollution is satisfied for various pollution-related genes.
LanguageData.VRE_ToxAbsorption.label: tox absorption
